check_labels.not_customer: Not a current or former customer
check_labels.not_duplicate: Not a duplicate of an older account
check_labels.lost_cooldown: Not lost in the last 90 days
check_labels.icp: Big enough and in a target industry
check_labels.pacing: Not contacted too recently or too often
check_labels.data_fresh: Company data is current and complete

contact: Passed every check and is worth a personal email: a first email, or a follow-up if the company already got earlier ones. It is prepared automatically and held until a person approves it. Nothing has been sent: once approved, it is only recorded in a simulated log.
nurture: Eligible, but a weak fit for now. No email and no AI: it joins the slow nurture track and is scored again at the next event.
wait: Not the right moment (recently contacted or recently lost). The system waits and checks again.
suppress: Should not receive outreach (opted out, customer, competitor, open deal or poor fit).
handoff_ae: Already has an owner, so it goes to the right sales exec instead of an automatic email.
enrich: Data is missing or outdated, so the system looks it up before doing anything else.
escalate_human: Conflicting or unusual situation. The system does not guess.

codes.STATE_CONFLICT: The CRM contradicts itself (customer without a won deal, or the reverse)
codes.AE_ASSIGNED: Already assigned to a sales exec
codes.NO_AE_AVAILABLE: No sales exec available right now
codes.NOT_ICP: Too small or not a target industry
codes.SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED: Already received the full email sequence
codes.STALE_ENRICHMENT: Company data is out of date
codes.MISSING_FIRMOGRAPHICS: Company size or industry is missing
codes.ENRICHMENT_EXHAUSTED: Data lookups did not fix it

contact: The system decides and prepares the email on its own. A person approves it before anything is sent.

wait: The system holds the account and checks it again by itself.
enrich: The data lookup runs by itself. Outreach waits for better data.
suppress: Stopping is safe to automate: the system blocks outreach and nothing is sent.
